title: Just ok.
text: Just ok.. This basket is just ok. It’s a bit too lightweight to be considered sturdy. And kind of small. All 4 castors lock and the wheels move smoothly but they too are light and feel like they might bend off after putting a bag of flour and a bag of rice in this. The entire unit seems to tilt forward too so I’ve had to finagle the wheels even further. I doubt I’d order this again. It was easy to put together though and would fit under sink cabinet as it’s only 19inches tall.
